title: Dev manifest, version 1 (.config/dev.json)
description: How tools work a repository's checkout: its services and ports, how to start and stop them, its commands and its links. Specification: docs/dev-manifest.md in github.com/FredricW/herdr-deck. The schema checks shape only; tools also check variables, cross-references (needs, groups, ports) and dependency cycles.

version.description: The manifest format's version. Tools refuse a version they do not know.

name.description: Display name. Default: the main checkout's folder name.

path.description: Folders put in front of PATH for every command, first one first; relative to the worktree.

ports.description: Named ports, in display order: a fixed number, a per-worktree port from the shared port store ({base, range}), or a key in the project's state file ({state}).

groups.description: Named lists of services. `dev <group>` starts one; the group `default` (else every service) is what plain `dev` starts.

commands.description: Named commands. null means the repository has none. A string runs with /bin/sh -c, an array is an argv, an object with `run` adds options, and an object without `run` maps service names (and `*`) to commands.

setup.description: Make a fresh checkout or worktree ready. Runs in a terminal.

dev.description: Start the dev services in one command, in the background. One repository-wide command.

stop.description: Stop what `dev` started, in the background. One repository-wide command.

test.description: Run the tests. Runs in a terminal.

lint.description: Lint and type-check. Runs in a terminal.

format.description: Format the code in place. Runs in a terminal.

migrate.description: Apply database migrations. Runs in a terminal.

seed.description: Load development data. Runs in a terminal.

open.description: Open the app, instead of the first link.

teardown.description: Free what the worktree holds outside itself before it is removed. Runs in a terminal.

links.description: Pages to open for a worktree.

^x-.description: One tool's settings; other tools ignore them.

name.description: A port or service name; it becomes part of environment variable names (PORT_<name>).

template.description: A string in which $WORKTREE, $REPO, $DIRNAME, $BRANCH, $PORT_<name>, $env(NAME|fallback) and ${…} are expanded; $$ is a literal $.

needs.description: A service (or port) name, or a list of them.

files.description: dotenv files, relative to the worktree; later files win. They feed $env(…), and a command's environment when it sets loadEnv.

vars.description: Variables for every command and service.

state.description: The project's own per-worktree state file, which ports of the form {state: key} read.

oneOf.description: A fixed port, the same in every worktree.
A fixed port, the same in every worktree.
A port per worktree from the shared port store: the lowest free port in base … base+range-1.
A port the project writes in its state file, under this key.

run.description: A string runs with /bin/sh -c; an array is an argv, run without a shell.

dir.description: Where it runs, relative to the worktree.

loadEnv.description: Also load env.files into the environment.

terminal.description: true: run where the user sees it; false: in the background with a log.

needs.description: Services that must be ready before it runs.

perService.description: A command per service; `*` is what the plain command runs (else every entry, in order).

oneOf.description: The repository has no such command.

ready.description: When the service counts as ready. Default: its main port answers.

port.description: One of the service's ports; default its main one.

http.description: A path that must answer 200–399 to a GET.

timeout.description: How long to wait while starting what needs it. Default 60s.

dir.description: Where run runs, relative to the worktree.

run.description: Runs the service in the foreground; tools run it detached. Without run, something else starts it.

stop.description: Stops the service, instead of a signal.

ports.description: The service's ports, main one first. Default: the port with the service's name.

needs.description: Services that must be ready before this one starts.

log.description: The file holding the service's log. Default: the shared state folder.

needs.description: Services or ports that must be ready. Default: the ports the URL uses.

detect.description: Drift checks: warnings when the manifest and the repository's task runners disagree.

ignore.description: Drift IDs to silence, e.g. missing:lint or dangling:commands.test.api; * matches any characters.
